  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "ownerId" text NOT NULL,

  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

execute.description: Record avatars, covers and attachments with their owners
execute.sql:
INSERT INTO content."upload" ("id", "url", "ownerId", "createdAt")
                  SELECT gen_random_uuid()::text, refs.url, refs."ownerId", now()
                    FROM (
                          SELECT u."avatarUrl" AS url, u."id" AS "ownerId", 1 AS rank
                            FROM auth."user" AS u
                           WHERE u."avatarUrl" IS NOT NULL
                          UNION ALL
                          SELECT s."coverUrl", s."authorId", 2
                            FROM content."story" AS s
                           WHERE s."coverUrl" IS NOT NULL
                          UNION ALL
                          SELECT m."url", s."authorId", 3
                            FROM content."multimedia" AS m
                            JOIN content."chapter" AS c ON c."id" = m."chapterId"
                            JOIN content."story" AS s ON s."id" = c."storyId"
                         ) AS refs
                   WHERE refs.url ~ '(^|/)(avatars|covers|media)/[0-9a-f-]{36}\.[a-z0-9]+$'
                   ORDER BY refs.rank
                  ON CONFLICT ("url") DO NOTHING

execute.description: Raise each story's likeCount to at least its real chapter likes
execute.sql:
UPDATE content."story" AS s
                     SET "likeCount" = GREATEST(s."likeCount", real.n)
                    FROM (
                          SELECT c."storyId", count(*)::int AS n
                            FROM engagement."chapterLike" AS l
                            JOIN content."chapter" AS c ON c."id" = l."chapterId"
                           GROUP BY c."storyId"
                         ) AS real
                   WHERE s."id" = real."storyId"
                     AND s."likeCount" < real.n
